messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "check medicine label before injecting"
set: ["check medicine label before injecting", "check label of every pain medicine you take", "check the instructions on the label", "check your label for storage instructions", "read label of other medicine to check for potassium content", "check medicine label to see if should take with food or not", "check product label for complete list of ingredients", "check active ingredients on carton before use", "start steroid medicine before levothyroxine", "check with your doctor or pharmacist before combining medicines", "follow directions on prescription label", "ask your doctor before stopping the medicine", "heart rate check", "follow directions on prescription label carefully", "check the prescribing information", "check with healthcare provider before using over-the-counter products, vitamins, or herbal supplements"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "check label of every pain medicine you take",
    "check the instructions on the label",
    "check your label for storage instructions",
    "read label of other medicine to check for potassium content",
    "check medicine label to see if should take with food or not",
    "check product label for complete list of ingredients",
    "check active ingredients on carton before use",
    "check the prescribing information"
  ],
  "alias": "check medicine label before injecting"
}
